cases.name: Java SDK v2 requests resolve builder fields and environment variables
Kotlin can call the Java v2 SDK with builder requests and env reads

files.Worker.kt:
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Client
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.model.GetObjectRequest
fun run() {
  val client = S3Client.builder().build()
  val bucket = System.getenv("DATA_BUCKET")
  val request = GetObjectRequest.builder().bucket(bucket).build()
  client.getObject(request)
}
